ACO‑LLM

RESEARCH PROTOCOL · 2026

Adaptive Cognitive Orchestration for Resource-Constrained Local Language Models (ACO-LLM): A Contract-Driven Research Protocol with Formal Guarantees and Reference Implementation

The protocol describes a comparison of different ways to route tasks, verify their results, and repair failures under limited computing resources.

Open the protocol on Zenodo

Protocol summary

ACO‑LLM proposes a controller that uses a task contract to choose between direct inference and bounded tool use. Observable failures can trigger limited repair attempts. The planned evaluation compares it with a fixed-effort agent using the same local model and execution budgets, on matched Arabic and English tasks with controlled tool failures. The protocol reports no empirical model results.
